ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Provider Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent review of high-risk Medicaid providers in Minnesota and explore the potential for fraud and abuse.
questions: What were the findings of the review?
How many providers were found to be high-risk?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse in the Medicaid system. By following the money and examining public records, we can shed light on the extent of the problem and identify potential solutions.
